title: Pumps not updated in shift()/sync() → oracle manipulation
root_cause: Alternative entry points (shift, sync) skip _updatePumps() that swap() calls
detection: Map ALL entry points → side effects. Check if every path that changes reserves also updates oracle/TWAP

title: Rewards lost — _updateRewardIndex() advances lastBalance incorrectly
root_cause: Reward index update uses wrong balance snapshot, causing reward calculation drift
detection: Check reward/interest accrual: is the balance snapshot taken at the RIGHT time? Before or after state change?

title: Kyber swaps lack slippage protection
root_cause: New swap integration added without minAmountOut check
detection: Every swap/external trade MUST have slippage protection. Check: is there a minOut/maxIn parameter?

title: Interest rate not adjusted on healthy repayment profit
root_cause: Repayment profit not fed back into interest rate model
detection: Check: when protocol gains/loses value, does the rate model adjust? Or is it stale?

title: Hot Signer can pass arbitrary data to partially whitelisted functions
root_cause: Whitelist checks function selector but not calldata — signer can pass malicious params
detection: If whitelist checks only function selector: can the CALLER control params that change behavior?

title: Excess ETH not refunded when minting/increasing liquidity via NonfungiblePositionManager
root_cause: msg.value > required ETH, but excess not returned to user
detection: Payable functions: is excess ETH refunded? Check: msg.value vs actual cost

title: slot0 sqrtPriceX96 can be manipulated (price manipulation)
root_cause: Using Uniswap V3 slot0 (spot price) instead of TWAP — manipulable in same tx
detection: Check oracle source: slot0() = SPOT = manipulable. Must use TWAP/observe()

title: V3SwapExactOutput applies fee to wrong amount
root_cause: Fee applied to input amount instead of output amount in exact-output swap
detection: For exact-input vs exact-output: is the fee applied to the CORRECT side?

title: fullRefundLeftoverGas always false — inner message check missing
root_cause: Boolean flag never set to true because condition checks wrong message type
detection: Trace boolean flags: is there a code path that sets it to true? Or is it always false?

title: effectiveGasPriceDec uses hardcoded param, not user-specific
root_cause: Gas price calculation uses global constant instead of per-user value
detection: Check: does this calculation use the RIGHT input? User-specific vs global?
